## About

Currently completing the final year of my Master's degree in Bioinformatics at the 
University of Nantes, I am finishing my end-of-studies internship at the Centre 
d'Anthropobiologie et de Génomique de Toulouse (CAGT).

My ambition: **designing and developing robust software tools** in service of biology 
and clinical research. I specialise in highly reproducible data processing architectures 
(Snakemake/SLURM pipelines) and the integration of Machine Learning and Deep Learning 
models applied to complex biological problems.

From ancient DNA to computational modelling of synaptic plasticity, my experiences 
have built a **strong interdisciplinary flexibility**: I adapt quickly to new biological 
domains while bringing solid expertise in software engineering and data analysis.

Graduating at the end of 2026, I am open to opportunities as a Research Engineer, 
fixed-term or permanent contract.
